verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for an AI email client, but the evidence never documents user-defined rules, triggers, or automatic actions on events such as incoming mail. The MCP capabilities (label changes, bulk archive/delete, send drafts) are on-demand tool calls, not event-driven rules. The founder's mention of auto-categorization is a built-in AI behavior, not something the user defines, so it is adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
